answer.reason: The verses tell of Gedaliah's oath to the captains and his death, beyond what the summary states as relations and office.

clauses.english: swore to the captains and their men that they should serve the Chaldees and it would be well with them
clauses.quote: Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon

clauses.english: disbelieved the warning of Johanan that Ishmael had been sent to slay him
clauses.quote: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.

doubts: The summary already says he was killed by Ishmael, so the killing is not given as a clause.
The reception of Jeremiah into his care (JER 39:14, 40:6) was left out as a minor detail.
